test_title: PYST 56: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) WA - SF 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4f01b75e3224a273a9a86e9b43cdba73ba75f3c8bdbc18702211fa2bfb75f32.png] 

Option 2) DY - ZD 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e38a2fb0722e7007fc49aa59ffe473a5e00726450494d1b00fad26851604d9d.png] 

Option 3) ZG - VL 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a678928a52fdbcd9eccad9d71df575d31511aa3659f738e49093025d66c9d17b.png] 

**Option 4) ME - HJ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44188c27c54a5c0eeae3d7841713f819ef2f570e15e573c76a95e780f1bb0260.png] 

Here, 'ME - HJ' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
